parameters.jsCode:
const facts = $input.first().json.facts

const lines = [
  'Write a professional, factual royalty-discrepancy message using ONLY the verified facts in the JSON below.',
  'State only what the verified facts show. Do not present inferences as facts.',
  'Do not calculate, round, or modify plays, actual payout, expected payout, difference, or any rate.',
  'Do not invent or infer rates, contracts, payment dates, contractual obligations, distributor policies, previous correspondence, reference numbers, territories, tiers, legal conclusions, or currency conversions.',
  'Omit unavailable details instead of filling them in.',
  'Return only this JSON object: {"subject":"string","body":"string","facts_used":[],"missing_information":[]}',
  'facts_used must list the exact verified fact key names used in the draft body.',
  'missing_information may list requested context that was unavailable.',
  'Verified facts:',
  JSON.stringify(facts, null, 2),
]

return [{ json: { facts: facts, prompt: lines.join('\n') } }]

options.systemPromptTemplate: You are drafting a royalty-discrepancy email. Use only the verified facts supplied in the input. Return only the schema-shaped object. facts_used must list the exact verified fact key names you referenced. Never calculate, round, or modify plays, actual payout, expected payout, difference, shortfall, or any rate. Never invent rates, contracts, payment dates, reference numbers, territories, tiers, legal conclusions, or previous correspondence. Omit unavailable details rather than filling them in.
